answer: New identities enter the lagoon: a quarantine pool where each locks a bond of 85,000 POA and trades only small amounts. Each epoch a beacon picks one identity at random for a ripple test — it must show one fresh proof of real work, checked by two peers from different clusters. A fake proof burns the bond, half goes to the reporter, the identity is banned 12 epochs and its lagoon slot is revoked. Forging 1,000 fake identities burns 1,000 × 85,000 = 85,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond of 85,000 POA once. The limit: a random beacon can miss a well-hidden fake for several epochs.
